title: Matrix Consumables
doc: Slice toggle. Off: Slices.VerdictForOverlay skips every file below before
it is opened, so none of its rows reach RulePlan. These files are loaded
by the row-edit engine, so they also have no effect while [Slices]
ModelRules is off (ModelRules.Init returns before Overlays.Load).
Files this toggle gates:
consumables-matrix.csv
ItemClass 7.
ItemModel's consumables are split into six sheets by ItemClass: 1 medical,
2 grenades, 3 devices, 4 chems, 6 sploitkits, 7 matrix. There is no
ItemClass 5.
Lever sheet, not a direct overlay: the first column is ItemName, not a row
id. Consumables.cs owns the whole parse and expands each row at load into
writes on up to three tables: ItemModel keyed on ItemTypeId, TalentModel
keyed on the row's TalentId, and the payload table keyed on the row's
EffectId / MatrixEffectId. Lever cells take blank, =N, +N, -N or xN.
A blank identity cell means the row reaches no row of that table. Unlike
Cyberweapons.cs and Implants.cs, Consumables.cs does not treat that as a
malformed row; a payload cell on such a row is refused and named. A
non-blank, non-integer id refuses the whole row.
Two payload tables. In the game data 5 of the 11 items reach an
EffectModel row and 7 reach a MatrixEffectModel row; Eclipse Microdust
(ItemTypeId 5404) reaches both [measured].
MatrixEffectModel payload columns carry a Matrix prefix in the header
(MatrixActionPoints, MatrixInstant, ...) because EffectClassification
and ActionPoints exist in both effect tables. The prefix is applied to
every MatrixEffectModel column, not only the two that collide, so the
rule is uniform. MatrixEffect and MatrixDuration are real TalentModel
columns, not aliases, and MatrixEffectId is an identity column.
Blue Juice's MatrixDuration 0 is an instantaneous effect, not a bug
(David).
Striatum Catalyst NMF (ItemTypeId 5403) is hidden in the GUI only:
gui/serve.py does not draw it and prints a legend line saying so.
scripts/consumables.py still generates the row and Consumables.cs still
expands it.
uiDoc: Turn this off and the mod skips this page's files, so nothing on this page is applied.

fields.label: Enable Matrix Consumables
fields.doc: On applies this slice's files; off skips them before they are opened. Default true. Lever sheet, not a direct overlay: the first column is ItemName, and there is no game table called "consumables-matrix".
